reason: The preregistered RA230-240/Dec5-15 field yielded 25 cold strict anchors because E(B-V)<0.03 left 11,492 of 4,647,352 PSF rows. Add two spatially independent high-latitude fields for a useful count while retaining every original final-field result.
selection_before_source_processing: Chosen from sky coordinates and existence of DR11 south sweep files. No source rows, Gaia labels, spectroscopy or residuals from these supplemental fields were inspected before registration.
reporting_rule: Report all registered final and supplemental fields, including fields below 200 anchors; do not drop a field based on its measured performance.
